research_policy.verified: Requirement checked against a primary curriculum source.
research_policy.partially_verified: Primary authority/document identity is verified, but detailed content was cross-checked through an accessible transcription or mirror and still requires direct page-level verification before publication as a verbatim quotation.
research_policy.pending_textbook_mapping: The national curriculum gives a stage-level requirement; exact single-grade placement must be verified against the relevant approved textbook edition/teacher guide.
research_policy.rule: MathBridge should paraphrase requirements in the teacher-facing UI and retain source locators internally. Do not imply that Common Core represents every US state.

CN.important_note: The 2022 national mathematics standard groups primary requirements into Grades 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6. It does not itself provide the same year-by-year granularity as England or Common Core. Exact Grade 1 vs Grade 2 sequencing should be added from an approved textbook edition rather than inferred.

progression.summary_en: Develop meaning for whole numbers up to 10,000 in real contexts; understand positional value; compare numbers; connect quantities, representations and written numerals.
progression.summary_cn: 在现实情境中理解万以内数的意义和数位含义，比较数的大小，并把数量、表征与数字符号联系起来。
progression.source_locator: 课程内容 → 小学部分 → 数与代数 → 第一学段（1-2年级）→ 数与运算；学业要求；教学提示
teaching_signals: Begin with familiar quantities and concrete representations.
Move from quantity to numeral representation.
Make the value of a digit depend explicitly on its position.
Use the transition from 9 to 10 to establish a new place and unit of ten.
Extend the same structural idea to larger whole numbers.

progression.summary_en: Extend whole-number understanding beyond 10,000 and develop the decimal base-ten numeration system; use estimation and large-number structure in problem solving.
progression.summary_cn: 认识万以上的数，了解十进制计数法，并在估算和解决实际问题中继续发展数感。
progression.source_locator: 课程内容 → 小学部分 → 数与代数 → 第二学段（3-4年级）→ 数与运算

progression.summary_en: Place-value structure is no longer presented mainly as expansion to ever-larger whole numbers; it is applied within decimal and fraction meaning, counting units and consistent reasoning about operations.
progression.summary_cn: 位值与计数单位的思想继续用于小数、分数和运算一致性的理解，而不是主要作为更大整数范围的独立主题推进。
progression.source_locator: 课程内容 → 小学部分 → 数与代数 → 第三学段（5-6年级）→ 数与运算；教学提示

UK.scope_note: UK mode currently means England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have separate curriculum systems and should not be represented by this mapping.

progression.summary: Count, read and write to 100; represent and compare numbers; begin recognising place value beyond 20 using objects and pictorial representations.
progression.source_locator: Year 1 → Number - number and place value

progression.summary: Recognise tens and ones in two-digit numbers; represent, estimate, compare and order numbers to at least 100; use place value to solve problems.
progression.range_or_structure: two-digit place value; to at least 100
progression.source_locator: Year 2 → Number - number and place value

progression.summary: Recognise hundreds, tens and ones in three-digit numbers; compare, order, represent and partition numbers up to 1,000.
progression.source_locator: Year 3 → Number - number and place value

progression.summary: Recognise thousands, hundreds, tens and ones; compare numbers beyond 1,000; round to 10, 100 or 1,000; begin extending place-value understanding into decimals.
progression.source_locator: Year 4 → Number - number and place value

progression.summary: Read, write, order and compare numbers to at least 1,000,000; determine digit values; use powers-of-ten steps and rounding; apply the number system to decimals and fractions.
progression.source_locator: Year 5 → Number - number and place value

progression.summary: Read, write, order and compare numbers up to 10,000,000; determine digit values; round whole numbers to required accuracy and use negative numbers in context.
progression.source_locator: Year 6 → Number - number and place value

US.scope_note: These records describe Common Core State Standards for Mathematics as MathBridge's baseline US reference framework. US states may use Common Core, modified standards or different state standards; state layers should be added separately.

progression.summary: Develop two-digit place value as tens and ones; compare two-digit numbers; use place-value reasoning with addition and subtraction within 100.
progression.source_locator: Grade 1 → Number and Operations in Base Ten (1.NBT)

progression.summary: Develop three-digit place value as hundreds, tens and ones; count and write to 1,000; compare three-digit numbers; use place value to explain addition and subtraction strategies.
progression.source_locator: Grade 2 → Number and Operations in Base Ten (2.NBT)

progression.summary: Apply place-value understanding to rounding and multi-digit arithmetic rather than adding a new dedicated place-value-understanding cluster.
progression.range_or_structure: round to nearest 10 or 100; arithmetic within 1,000
progression.source_locator: Grade 3 → Number and Operations in Base Ten (3.NBT)

progression.summary: Generalise base-ten place value for multi-digit whole numbers: each place is ten times the place to its right; read, write, compare and round multi-digit whole numbers.
progression.range_or_structure: whole numbers up to 1,000,000 in this domain
progression.source_locator: Grade 4 → Number and Operations in Base Ten (4.NBT)

progression.summary: Extend base-ten place value to decimals: each place is ten times the place to its right and one tenth of the place to its left; read, write, compare and round decimals to thousandths.
progression.range_or_structure: whole-number powers of ten and decimals to thousandths
progression.source_locator: Grade 5 → Number and Operations in Base Ten (5.NBT)

progression.summary: There is no separate Number and Operations in Base Ten domain in Grade 6. Students apply prior base-ten understanding to fluent multi-digit decimal operations and extend the number system to negative and rational numbers.

comparison_insights.statement_en: The three systems organise progression differently: China's national standard is stage-based, England publishes year-by-year expectations, and Common Core publishes grade-by-grade standards.
comparison_insights.statement_cn: 三个体系的课程颗粒度不同：中国国家课标按学段组织，英格兰按学年列出要求，Common Core按年级列出标准。

comparison_insights.statement_en: A simple 'same grade = same content' comparison is misleading. For example, China's first learning stage expects understanding of whole numbers within 10,000 by the end of Grade 2, while England Year 2 focuses primarily on two-digit place value and Common Core Grade 2 focuses on three-digit numbers to 1,000.
comparison_insights.statement_cn: 不能把“同年级”直接视为“同内容”。例如，中国第一学段到二年级结束要求理解万以内数，而英格兰Year 2主要聚焦两位数位值，Common Core二年级则系统发展到三位数和1000以内。

comparison_insights.statement_en: Across all three systems, place value is not only a naming-of-digits topic; it is used as structural knowledge for comparison, estimation and arithmetic.
comparison_insights.statement_cn: 三个体系都不把位值仅仅视为“认识数位名称”，而是把它作为数的比较、估算和运算的重要结构基础。

next_research: Verify approved PEP textbook edition sequencing for Grades 1-6 so China can be shown year-by-year without inventing grade placement.
Add DfE 2020 ready-to-progress criteria and NCETM materials to describe England teaching representations, not just statutory outcomes.
Add at least two state layers to US mode (recommended: California plus Texas) so Common Core is clearly a baseline rather than 'the US curriculum'.
Attach claim-level research on concrete/pictorial representations, place-value charts, base-ten blocks and number lines.
